game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Eruption Watch, the volcano watchtower: the forge smith must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on ash wraiths.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Eruption Watch: the volcano watchtower
core_gameplay_loop: In Eruption Watch, repeat each round: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on ash wraiths. Each round, ash wraiths strike the lava bridge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the damage value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the lava bridge from ash wraiths in Eruption Watch: keep the damage meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 39-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: damage drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 39-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 4 (applied tier): Arithmetic Cannon
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Arithmetic Cannon' (Week 2 slot 2), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Eruption Watch'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how damage changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ash wraiths in Eruption Watch.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 39 seconds while damage > 0.
